notes.title: Going Down NextFest Showcase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620744/5a03bc4563c6b918e89272dc1c8e03be56937256.png[/img]

[h2]Hang out with Team Mytholite[/h2]
Spend the evening with us, explore Going Down, find out the reasons behind our creative decisions, and learn a little more about the game. This will be a great opportunity to get a sneak peek at the game.

[h2]Talk about the future[/h2]
What comes after Going Down? We'd love to share our excitement about future projects with you, and get your opinions on what you'd like to see from us in the future.

[h2]Ask us anything[/h2]
We are eager to answer any questions you may have for us. We will hold an open Q&A session for you to get your voices heard and questions answered.

[h2]Play along with us[/h2]
We will play the Going Down demo along with you and give you an insight into our creative vision, explaining some of the secrets within.
